dataList.content:
Meursault, Dante... What am I?
默尔索，但丁……我是什么？

What is my nature? Why did I have to be born this way?
我的本性究竟是什么……才会让我生来如此？

Am I memory, or experience?
我究竟是记忆，还是经验呢。

... I already know the answer. Look at me, gobbling up everything... "Experience" must be what I am.
……我知道了。看这副无论什么都贪婪吞下的丑态，我一定是经验吧……

Buffet, why did you...
自助餐，你为什么……

... "Pwie."
……吱咿。

Call me... by that name.
请以那个名字……来呼唤我。

... Pwie.
……吱咿。

Why did you stop?
你为什么停止了和我们的战斗。

... Because...
因为……

Because I didn't want to fight you anymore.
我已经不想再和你们战斗了。

You know, climbing this place all alone, everything felt... so cold and hard.
这独自向上爬升的路途……太冷、也太坚硬了。

It must have been difficult for you.
你一定很痛苦吧。

... Did your feet hurt?
……你的脚不会疼吗。

They hurt. They still hurt.
很疼。现在还是很疼。

So will you... put those flower shoes on me again?
所以……能再次为我穿上那双花鞋吗？

... We will.
……我们会的。

And then...
那样的话，我也……

And then... can I come with you... again?
也还能再和你们同行吗？

Yes, you can.
嗯，会那样吧。
